description.en: Read the article of the focused browser tab as plain, readable text in a pane: title, byline, headings, paragraphs, lists, quotes and code.
description.ja: フォーカス中のブラウザタブの記事を、読みやすいテキストとしてペインに表示します。

scopes.page:read: Read the article text and links of the browser tab you are looking at.
scopes.actions:run: Open the Reader pane, and open a link or image you click in a browser tab.
scopes.storage:local: Keep the last article you read on this Mac, so the pane still shows it after a reload.
